title: Remove neighbors together
hook: Predict the product, then compare the bonds.

knows: Structural formula bonds and common organic functional groups.
doesNotKnow: In an E2 elimination a base removes a β hydrogen as bromide leaves, forming a carbon–carbon double bond. Both ends of this symmetrical substrate lead to propene.

misconception: Reaction conditions do not affect the connectivity of the product.
objective: Predict the organic product of 2-bromopropane under the stated conditions and identify the changed connectivity.

claims.text: Question, structural diagrams, product and explanation: 2-bromopropane is treated with a strong base under E2 conditions. Which major organic product forms after workup? In an E2 elimination a base removes a β hydrogen as bromide leaves, forming a carbon–carbon double bond. Both ends of this symmetrical substrate lead to propene.
The diagrams use condensed labels and depict connectivity rather than molecular geometry; highlighting identifies selected changed groups.
